LanguageData.LP_DivineSpark.label: divine spark
LanguageData.LP_DivineSpark.description: A grain of divinity made solid; not hot to the touch, yet hard to look at for long. Only the person it fell for can absorb it (channeling 12 hours in the ascension ritual). While a spark is on the map, colonists get mood +4. Cannot be sold.
LanguageData.LP_UsurpedSpark.label: usurped divine spark
LanguageData.LP_UsurpedSpark.description: A dark red spark seized from a god-possessed pawn, still carrying its owner's wrath. Any colonist can try to absorb it, but the usurping ritual may fail. Cannot be sold.
